entities.name: Kavajë Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Kubelie Mosque, also known as the Kapllan Beu Mosque, is a mosque in Kavajë, Albania. This mosque was built in 1735 CE under the Ottomans by Kapllan Beu. The Old Mosque, stood on the main street of the city, about 70 metres (230 ft) to the east of the current mosque.
